ceu: ✦ The trine between the Sun and Jupiter

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
From {H:1797712182000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Say no to a request that takes you away from your priorities.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
From {H:1797712182000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Settle an old matter before starting something new.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
From {H:1797712182000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Join a group or a conversation about a subject you enjoy.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
From {H:1797712182000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, routine and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Show your work: people who do not show up are not remembered.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
From {H:1797712182000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Listen to a podcast or a talk on a new subject.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
From {H:1797712182000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Write on a piece of paper what you want to be free of and tear it up.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
From {H:1797712182000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Clear up a misunderstanding with a calm conversation.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
From {H:1797712182000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, money and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Tidy your desk before you start.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
From {H:1797712182000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Write something lovely about someone you care for.

t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.
From {H:1797712182000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Phone an older relative and listen to them without hurry.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.
From {H:1797712182000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to home and family.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Learn a new word or a new thing today, out of curiosity.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.
From {H:1797712182000}, the Moon moves into {S:1} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.

The trine between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Cook a meal you love at home and savour it slowly.
